title: Warm Yeasty Malaysian Cauliflower Braise
description: This Malaysian-inspired dish features tender cauliflower in a rich, yeasty sauce, perfect for a quick and flavorful meal. It is also FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the malaysian curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cauliflower florets and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the yeast extract, garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 15 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender.
Serve the cauliflower hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
